Xech Eon Max Portable Speaker With Wireless Charger, Alarm Clock & Retro Radio Style

The Xech Eon Max portable speaker with wireless charger is a smart blend of timeless design and modern audio technology. Built in a charming retro radio style, this compact yet powerful device works beautifully on a bedside table or study desk while delivering rich sound, fast connectivity, and everyday convenience. Whether you want a Bluetooth 5.3 speaker for seamless streaming, a reliable alarm clock for your morning routine, or a 15W wireless charging pad for your phone, the Eon Max brings everything together in one elegant unit.

Designed for music lovers and multitaskers, the Xech Eon Max portable speaker with wireless charger helps reduce cable clutter while upgrading your décor. The vintage-inspired body paired with adjustable brightness makes it perfect for night use, giving you clear visibility without disturbing your sleep. From relaxing playlists to podcasts, from charging your device to waking up on time, this all-in-one solution fits effortlessly into modern lifestyles.

Thanks to the latest Bluetooth 5.3 speaker technology, you get faster pairing, stable connections, and energy-efficient performance. If you prefer wired playback, simply plug in with AUX or TF card and keep the music going without interruption. The speaker produces balanced audio with crisp highs and deep bass, making it ideal for personal listening in bedrooms, dorm rooms, or workspaces.

More than just a speaker, the doubles as a stylish table accessory. Its retro radio style adds personality to minimal interiors, while the compact footprint ensures it never occupies too much space. Place it on your bedside table for nighttime charging and alarms, or keep it on your study desk for productivity with background music.

The integrated 15W wireless charging pad is optimized for fast and safe power delivery. Just set your compatible smartphone on top and let it charge cable-free. The adjustable brightness display ensures the time is always visible, day or night. With intuitive controls and dependable build quality, this device makes everyday tech simpler and smarter.

Key Features

  • Classic retro radio style that enhances bedside table and study desk aesthetics
  • Advanced Bluetooth 5.3 speaker for stable, quick, and power-efficient connectivity
  • Supports plug in with AUX or TF card for versatile playback options
  • High-speed 15W wireless charging for compatible smartphones
  • Clear LED display with adjustable brightness for comfortable night viewing
  • Compact, space-saving design ideal for bedrooms, offices, and dorms
  • Balanced sound output with impressive clarity and bass
  • User-friendly buttons for volume, alarms, and playback control
  • Great gift choice for tech lovers, students, and professionals

If you are searching for a premium bedside table speaker that also powers your phone, the is a dependable pick. Its combination of retro radio style, modern Bluetooth 5.3 speaker capability, and flexible input options like AUX or TF card ensures it adapts to your routine effortlessly. Upgrade your desk or nightstand with a device that does more than play music. Enjoy wireless freedom, organized spaces, and a timeless look – all packed into one beautifully designed unit.
